text: On the medium and high settings the whole island is now made of the same small cubes, close up and from far away: no more ring where the land changes as you zoom. Flat ground is calmer, its colours in wide soft patches. Sand slopes no longer look like a washboard, snowy slopes stay white, and dark cliffs are a little lighter. Every tree and house is drawn in the small cubes at every distance, and a big tree has more cubes rather than bigger ones.
